coder_notes: Multi-cohort trial: GBM IDH-wildtype and IDH-mutant astrocytoma (NEO212 alone) plus solid tumours with brain metastases (NEO212 + SOC). Coded basket (solid tumours explicitly eligible; GBM named in conditions); mixed_glioma_gbm_named would also fit. Trial-level regimen coded combination because most experimental arms add SOC drugs; the GBM cohort is NEO212 alone. SOC partners are soc_backbone (SOC for the brain-metastasis indications) and FOLFIRI is split into its components. NEO212 has no INN; code retained as first written. PD-L1 and MSI/dMMR apply only to partner (pembrolizumab/nivolumab) cohorts, so not candidate-matched. Tumour PK: PK planned, sample type not stated.
